Subject: Close Stabilization: Day-of Commit Snapshot and Stage Locks

Team —

Attaching my working snapshot from this morning (pipeline_snapshot_20261130.csv). We have one major motion today: lock legitimate "Commit" deals in the CRM by noon PT and flag anything that still needs legal/PO as "Commit-Pending". This keeps finance and ops from double-counting in today's close.

Please:
- Update stage to Commit in HubSpot for deals you intend to carry to revenue this quarter.
- If a signed SOW or PO exists, attach or link it in the deal (include file name).
- If any outstanding blockers (legal, security, billing), add a one-line note in the deal and mark owner.

Key note: SpectraSoft (RDW-2026-SS-5412) is showing as Highly Likely but currently lacks a signed SOW in the record. I want this resolved before EOD.

I've drawn a short checklist in the snapshot for quick review — look at the rightmost two columns (Forecast Flag / Docs).

I'll run a 24-hour rollup tomorrow morning to finalize the close-state for finance. Ping me directly if you need a quick call.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Head of Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

A couple quick governance points for today:
- If a deal does NOT have a signed SOW/PO by close-of-business PT, it should be left as Commit-Pending. Finance will treat Commit-Pending as upside — do not push to committed revenue.
- Any deal moved to Commit needs an owner listed in the deal and an attach/link to the signed document. No exceptions without an explicit exec approval.

Marcus, please coordinate with Finance (cc’d) to make sure we have a conservative rounding approach for any borderline cases. We want clean numbers for the board deck.
